messages.subject: Project Lyra – completion summary
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Helena,

A short note to confirm Project Lyra is complete. Headline terms: 5-year initial term; £185,000 implementation; £312,000 annual subscription; £96,000 annual O&M; 18% shared-savings; RPI uplift capped at 4%. We held the liability cap at 125% of trailing 12-months' Charges with a £1,000,000 super-cap for data-protection breaches, and a 99.7% availability SLA with a 10% quarterly service-credit cap.

Our final invoice will follow within budget. Congratulations to the team.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
